items.finding: desired-visible and actual-visible overlays can lack current pixel evidence when live screenshot capture is disabled
items.validation: bundle and screenshot validators must fail or explicitly downgrade evidence when visible overlays lack current pixel screenshots

items.finding: deterministic preview PNGs can look capture-derived while using SessionPreviewTelemetryFixtures
items.validation: preview artifacts must carry explicit fixture provenance and cannot be treated as live/capture-specific evidence

items.finding: localhost overlays can still expose redundant overlay titles after title chrome was supposed to be removed
items.validation: localhost/browser models and screenshot manifests reject rendered-title fields for ordinary product overlays

items.finding: browser, localhost, and native surfaces can drift because settings application is not proven by a shared settings fingerprint
items.validation: effective settings must expose per-surface shared-settings fingerprints and parity validators must compare them

items.finding: row counts can match while rendered row identities, placeholders, or clipped rows differ across surfaces
items.validation: table overlays must expose row identity, placeholder, and column-key evidence that parity checks compare

items.finding: Standings status can claim more rows than are actually rendered, and race intervals can contain impossible timing values
items.validation: standings validators reject visible-row/status mismatches and absurd interval values relative to displayed gap scale

items.finding: collapsed or unavailable content can leave oversized shells, and null fuel need can render as covered
items.validation: metric overlays must expose rendered row density and unavailable fuel strategy states must not render success copy

items.finding: Input State preview can render unavailable despite fixture controls and trace data being present
items.validation: input-state preview contracts require available fixture inputs, non-empty trace evidence, and rail/graph parity

items.finding: Gap preview can show graph content while marked unavailable or waiting for fresh telemetry
items.validation: graph overlays cannot expose rendered series/trend content in unavailable states unless explicitly marked stale-history evidence

items.finding: circle fallback maps can be marked live even when the current track has no readable map
items.validation: track-map validators distinguish generated maps from circle fallback and require current-track provenance

items.finding: IBT analysis can succeed against a different car/track/day and hide the selected source path in summary metadata
items.validation: IBT diagnostics must expose selected source identity and downgrade mismatched sidecars instead of reporting clean success

items.finding: localhost diagnostics can prove request stats without proving every overlay route rendered
items.validation: localhost screenshot and diagnostics validation require per-overlay route/model/screenshot coverage, not just last-request evidence

items.finding: Garage Cover can appear in browser metadata while missing from live and preview evidence manifests
items.validation: coverage validators require every supported overlay to declare native/browser/localhost support or an explicit unsupported reason

items.finding: race captures can have aggregate race data while sampled frame examples are exhausted by Warmup
items.validation: diagnostic sample validation requires per-session sample coverage or an explicit per-session omission reason

items.finding: fixture flags, forced radar states, and suppressed chat sources can be mistaken for captured live evidence
items.validation: overlay manifests must classify synthetic mixed states, suppressed external sources, and capture-data limitations distinctly
